additional_info.subject: 170000452 - Dual DC Connector Fault Issue
additional_info.body:
Hello Siemens Support Team,
We would like to report a recurring issue with DC charger unit number 170000452.
Whenever a charging session is initiated on one of the DC connectors (Combo CCS), the second connector immediately transitions to a Faulted state.
According to the logs:
The active connector changes to "In Use" as expected
The second connector changes from "Available" to "Faulted"
Error Code received: 001 - Other type of error (Vendor error code: EVSE is not ready)
This behavior occurs consistently during every charging session, or whenever one connector becomes active.
We would appreciate your investigation to determine whether this is related .
Log screenshots are attached for reference.
Thank you in advance for your support.
Best regards,
​
​
​
​
Ziv Vinitzer
Head of DC Charging

additional_info.subject: Re:‏ ID0474960-DC/Si-D/IL- [MP / P4 170000452] Dual DC Connector Fault Issue CRM:03289000385
additional_info.body:
Dear Ayushi,
Thank you for your response and for checking the charger status.
Please note that the issue is not permanent and therefore may not appear as an active error during your remote check.
The fault occurs only while a charging session is active on one DC connector.
During the session, the second DC connector immediately changes from Available to Faulted.
Once the charging session ends, the charger automatically returns to normal and both connectors show Available again.
This is why no active error is currently visible.
Additional details:
The issue occurs on the secondary outlet while the other outlet is charging
It happens consistently during every charging session
Example timestamps (from SCC logs): Jan 28, 2026 around 11:14 - 11:23 AM
Error observed: Error Code 001 - EVSE is not ready
We have checked the cable heads and there are no visible signs of wear or overheating.
I am attaching a screenshot from the SCC system showing the Faulted status and the related events during the charging session for your reference.
Please let us know if you require additional logs or if you would like us to reproduce the issue at a specific time for live monitoring.
Best regards,
Ziv
